why: Two findings of the 18 Oct audit. (1) Round 3's fleet normal grouped recordings by the full condition name, which includes the radial force (F04/F10); FR-002 says a drive cannot know that force. (2) The published audit we compare with (Cekic and Akan, Energies 2026) splits by bearing AND leaves each operating condition out in turn; our round 3 only swapped two loads, so the comparison was not like for like. Round 4 fixes (1) and runs (2). Rounds 1 to 3 stay reported.
already_seen_before_this_seal: The 18 Oct audit check (research/force-check-2026-10-18.json) ran this detector's same-load test once at lab (0.8138) and 16k_12b (0.8202) to size the force problem. Those two numbers were seen before this seal; nothing below was chosen because of them. Everything else here is unseen.
fleet_normal: for each drive setting (speed and torque only, the force part dropped as FR-002 says) and each feature: (x - median) / (IQR + 1e-6), median and IQR over the usable recordings of the reference bearings at that setting, without labels. Reference bearings = the training bearings of the fold (inner folds: the inner training bearings). Setting columns stay raw.

candidates_reported_not_chosen.name: shape+rf
candidates_reported_not_chosen.note: never looks at any recording from the test condition except the test bearing's own

same_load_test: as round 3: round-1 folds, all four conditions mixed; settings lab, 32k_12b, 16k_12b, 8k_12b, 16k_10b (detector only)
new_load_test: as round 3: N15_M07_F10 -> N15_M01_F10 and the reverse, at lab and 16k_12b, every candidate

leave_one_condition_out.why: the published protocol (Cekic and Akan 2026): bearing-level split plus each operating condition held out in turn
leave_one_condition_out.test: for each of the four conditions: labels only from the fold's training bearings at the other three conditions; the test bearings at the held-out condition scored once; the fleet normal at the held-out drive setting uses the training bearings' recordings at that setting without labels (HR-20); calibration, line and band from inner out-of-fold scores at the training conditions
leave_one_condition_out.report: per held-out condition: balanced accuracy with its 95% range, false alarms, misses, hand-off view; and the plain mean over the four held-out conditions (their 'all-split mean')
leave_one_condition_out.subsets: from the same predictions, balanced accuracy of healthy against: real wear on one ring (KA04 KA15 KA16 KA22 KA30 KI04 KI14 KI16 KI17 KI18 KI21; closest to their aged-only targets), all real wear (adds KB23 KB24 KB27), lab-made damage, and all damage (closest to their artificial-plus-aged target D)

differences_we_state: Cekic and Akan used CNNs on time-frequency images and their own split seeds; we use our sealed round-1 folds. Our fleet normal uses unlabelled recordings of the training bearings at the test condition; theirs did not (as far as their abstract says). The shape+rf candidate does not, and is shown beside it. Only six healthy bearings exist.
seen_bearings_number: as round 3, with this fleet normal, at lab and 16k_12b
ring_fr003: as round 3 (same rule, same show rule), with this fleet normal
damage_size_fr014: as round 3, from round 4's same-load predictions
authors_split_fr020: as round 3, with this fleet normal
plant_switch: the plant view moves to round 4 at 16k_12b whatever its score, because round 3 breaks FR-002; round 3's plant view stays reported
reported: all four rounds; every candidate's own score in every test; the audit check that came first
